name: Choke Slam (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Grab, 10 ft. (or greater) reach

Benefit(s): When you successfully grapple your opponent with your grab special ability you deal 1d6 points of additional damage and can choose to knock the opponent prone. If you have the constrict special ability this bonus applies to the damage inflicted with that ability each round.
